Title: Azure Database for MariaDB reserved capacity pricing is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MariaDB reserved capacity pricing is now available to reserve compute power for your existing and future MariaDB servers. Now save up to 49 percent compared to the regular pay-as-you-go payment option for your MariaDB server vCores in a three-year period.

For more information, see the Azure Database for MariaDB pricing page.
